answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity tends a garden of verifiable attestations across epochs, where only sustained honest work allows roots to deepen. The zenith of reputation is reached only by identities that weather seasonal audits—clones lack the seasonal memory of genuine growth and wither under scrutiny. The ripple of trust propagates only from anchored contributions; fakes create no wake in the ledger. An attacker must cultivate N independent gardens across epochs, paying full effort per plot while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward remains bounded.
